- review pass 1 verified ✅ host relaunched from bin on a temp data folder (CDP over 9333), drove A01 → sheet → «ابدأ» → A03: step-one hint now «أكمل الحقول ثم أنشئ الحساب», sheet shows «رقم الورقة ٢٠٢٦٠٩١٦/…», top bar reads the new narrow org line; keys\ carries no BUILTIN\Users grant while exports\ does; log holds only the start-up line; process killed. 57/57 tests, three builds clean.
- review pass 2 ✅ findings applied: SignIn/Recover now branch inside one `catch (CryptoException)` — WrongPassword/Tampered keep their old behaviour, every other code (Corrupt, UnknownKind) returns StorageFailed so A02 says «تعذّرت قراءة بيانات الأداة» instead of the click handler throwing (+2 tests that spoil a stored wrap's version); AdminAccountService.KeyFileUnreadable added and an unreadable-but-present key file now refuses with StorageFailed rather than NotCreated, with A01.OnInitialized guarded by the same flag so the two screens cannot bounce the person back and forth (+1 test); Recover opens the database BEFORE re-wrapping and saving, and closes it on failure, so a failed open no longer leaves the password silently changed (+1 test that holds admin.db open and proves the old password still works); AdminPrintOutcome.DialogOpened added and the chip reworded to «فُتحت نافذة الطباعة …» (PrintOpenedChip) so nothing claims a print that may not have happened; CopiedToast now says «نُسخ الرمز. الصقه في مكانه ثم امسح الحافظة.» and leaving A01 clears the clipboard through wakeelAdmin.clearCopiedText, plus a new CopyFailed sentence (a failed copy used to say printing was unavailable — caught on the live run); AdminDashboard gained PendingChanges + AlertCount read uncapped from the tables, and the alerts badge and summary now come from those instead of the LIMIT-20 list (+1 test with 25 waiting offices); AlertsNoneDesc(bool) says «لا شيء بانتظار الانتباه بعد.» on an empty organisation (+1 test); AdminAr.Dashboard.RevokedDevices(n) gives the adjective the right shape («١١ جهازًا مُلغى», not «مُلغاة») and both call sites use it (+1 test); unused QRCoder PackageReference dropped from Wakeel.Admin.csproj. Build green (0 warnings), 64/64 tests.

- review pass 3 ✅ findings applied: AdminKeyFile.Save gained an explicit `keepBackup` choice and deletes any existing admin.key.bak when the wrap set changed; Create() and Recover() both save with keepBackup:false and call RemoveRetiredKeyFileBackup() (try/catch IOException/UnauthorizedAccessException, same discipline as TryDeleteDatabase), with a test that forces a .bak to exist, recovers, then walks every file under keys\ and proves no password wrap anywhere still opens with the old password (+ a test that a fresh Create leaves no backup); AdminKeyFile.LockOutsToReport carries the served lock-outs past the shut database and SignIn()/Recover() write one «قُفل الدخول مؤقتًا…» row each through WriteServedLockOuts() once the database opens (+2 audit tests: two rounds → two rows written once only, and a lock-out served before a recovery still recorded); A01 «الخروج» while the sheet is unconfirmed opens the danger AdminConfirmDialog (RequireTypedConfirmation="false") and only closes on confirm, clearing the clipboard on the way (+2 bUnit tests with a TestAdminWindow that counts closes); A03's «تصدير ملف الإعداد» and «عرض الكل» are drawn disabled inside a WTooltip saying «هذا الجزء غير متاح في هذه النسخة بعد.» while AdminRoutes has no route for them (routes read once in OnInitialized) (+1 test); A01 MachineLine now reads AdminOptions.MachineName (+1 test); the strength meter shows «—» instead of a verdict while the password box is empty (+1 test); AdminDashboardService counts offices and devices through the whole parent chain (FromLiveOffices/FromLiveDevices), so a disabled unit takes its offices, their devices, their alerts and their last export off the board — the rule is written on AdminDashboard.Offices for admin-2 to inherit (+2 tests); dead strings SignIn.WrongPassword, Create.SheetOrgLabel and Dashboard.StructureEmptyAction deleted.
